Sebastian Kurz former Chancellor of Austria and now President & Co-Founder of DREAM who became one of the youngest national leaders in the world at just 31.
He explains:
• How he became the world's youngest national leader at 31 and what he had to give up to get there
• Why he believes Europe's migration crisis of 2015 is the one mistake the continent still refuses to admit
• How he defied Angela Merkel during the migration crisis and why he was not scared to do it
• What happens inside a prime minister's mind on election night waiting for results
